title: UI风格#83 - Space Station (太空站)
description: 创建第83种UI风格：太空站风格 - 国际空间站、仪表界面、无重力环境。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCE.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Station style When color palette Then features white panels, blue accent lights, warning orange, dark void
Given Space Station style When typography Then uses technical fonts: Share Tech Mono, Roboto Mono, or Fira Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Share Tech Mono (headers 2.8rem), Roboto Mono (body 0.9rem 400-700 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Station style When layout Then modular panels, instrument clusters, viewport frames
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: starfield background with drift animation, blue glow panel borders, module divider with satellite icon, station border with blue accent gradient

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Station style When UI elements Then status lights, panel buttons, floating elements
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: pulse animation on header icon, blue glow hover effects, status indicators (Orbiting/Idle), Share Tech Mono typography, floating star background

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Station UI When functional Then includes comm chat, astronaut agents, oxygen stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: communications module chat, 4 astronaut agents (Armstrong/Chen/Johnson/Gagarin) with O2/Missions/EVA/Docking/First stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Station UI When copy Then uses mission control: 'T-Minus', 'Launch', 'Orbit', 'Dock'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'T-MINUS. ORBIT. DOCK.', tagline 'MISSION CONTROL ONLINE', button 'TRANSMIT', greeting 'Comms online. All systems nominal', status 'Orbiting'/'Idle', nav 'Station'/'Engineering'/'Mission Data'/'Command'
